svg.title: Pack List: Wax crayon on kraft paper
svg.desc: Pack List (1D): in wax crayon on brown kraft paper, the friends sit round the fire as cards, with one empty seat nobody filled. The chain of packed items runs in a band above; one of them, a blue enamel kettle, was never added by anyone and is circled. Below, Tam's tray of item tiles holds the same kettle, and the button to say nobody said that.
svg.text: I packed my bag, and in it I put
